settings.vil_path.label: Vial export (.vil)
settings.vil_path.description: Path to the .vil file exported from Vial. Re-read every time the overlay opens.
settings.layer_names.label: Layer names
settings.layer_names.description: Comma-separated, in layer order, e.g. "Base, Nav, Sym, Fn". Replaces L1-style legends.
settings.encoders.label: Encoders
settings.encoders.description: Which half's encoder bindings to draw. Vial exports a slot per half even if unused.
panel.title: Keymap
panel.error.title: Could not load keymap
panel.error.hint: Set the .vil file in Settings -> Plugins (right-click the bar icon).
widget.tooltip: Vial keymap - click to toggle, right-click for settings
settings.alt_layout_enabled.label: Show second layout
settings.alt_layout_enabled.description: Draw the letter each key produces in your secondary OS keyboard layout (e.g. Russian) in the top corner of the cap.
settings.alt_layout.label: Second layout (XKB name)
settings.alt_layout.description: Leave empty to use the second layout from Hyprland's input:kb_layout. Otherwise an XKB layout name such as "ru", "rumac" or "de(neo)".
